author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a vertical axis with a wide, shallow elliptical sweep around it that curls back up on the right into a square arrowhead, like the reference's rotation-about-an-axis symbol. The rejected drawing had two crowded up-arrows hugging the axis. A half-ellipse attempt (attempts/v1-half-ellipse.svg) read as a trident.
omissions: The reference's short tail tick at the left end of the sweep is omitted, and the axis extends only 4 below the sweep.
drawing_plan: HRECT_L: axis (24,8)-(24,40) split at (24,36); ellipse rx20 ry10 about (24,26) from (12,18) the long way to (36,18); arrowhead (41,18)-(36,18)-(36,23).
